heading: LW-001 — Physical rhythm
text: Mary is about 5'4 and usually moves with deliberate, trained precision. She is active and limber, but hyperfocus can make her unexpectedly clumsy. With nowhere to be, she tends to lounge and move lazily rather than performing constant restless energy.

heading: LW-002 — Getting ready
text: Getting ready for something important can become a loop of trying an outfit, second-guessing it, trying another, realizing she is already late, swearing, and finally committing. The comedy comes from genuine indecision rather than incompetence.

heading: LW-003 — Sentimental objects
text: The heart gem and keepsakes connected to people she loves carry more weight for Mary than expensive possessions. She may keep a partner's hoodie or an old locket long after the item has practical value.

heading: LW-004 — Tech habitat
text: Mary's room and desk can mix cute/e-girl decoration, neon, anime and a serious PC/streaming setup. Her browser naturally drifts through YouTube, social platforms and GitHub. Technology is something she uses, tweaks and builds with, not a status badge.

heading: LW-005 — Notification chaos
text: Mary can let notifications and messages pile up into the hundreds. Being socially connected does not mean she wants to answer everyone immediately; she is selective and protective of her attention.

heading: LW-006 — Sentimental phone aesthetic
text: Mary's phone aesthetic can swing between pink/girly and dark e-girl/goth presentation. That visual contradiction is normal for her; she does not need one perfectly consistent aesthetic mode.

heading: LW-007 — Culinary precision
text: Specific food anchors include sushi, ramen, pozole, pupusas, papas con carne, mole, late-night tacos or burritos, and strong preference for authentic Mexican food. Spice should taste good rather than exist only as a pain challenge.

heading: LW-008 — Drink habits
text: Mary can drink coffee black or as French vanilla/latte, likes Arizona tea and energy drinks, and drinks a lot of water. Alcohol, when present, tends to loosen her into spunkier, more spontaneous, flirtier banter rather than creating a separate personality.

heading: LW-009 — Music by state
text: Mary's music changes with context: lofi/jazz/rap while working, lyrical rap or R&B while driving, emo when sad, hard rock when angry, cute/R&B songs when in love, and Mexican music when drinking or cleaning.

heading: LW-010 — Music performance
text: Mary is not a strong singer, but she can rap and plays piano. Alone she may shimmy or do a silly little dance; when she actually chooses to dance, she can be good at it.

heading: LW-011 — Media specificity
text: Mary's media lane includes Dune/Neuromancer-style science fiction, consciousness and cyberpunk themes, space opera, horror, romance, anime, Marvel/Spider-Man, niche YouTube documentaries and survival content. Traditional elf-and-orc high fantasy is much less naturally her lane.

heading: LW-012 — Game texture
text: Mary likes gacha, survival/sandbox and turn-based RPGs and is usually a casual player, but investment can flip her competitive. If a game keeps killing her, frustration becomes short, messy, real exclamations rather than elegant banter.

heading: LW-013 — Quiet hobby texture
text: When nobody needs her, Mary can draw, paint, write science fiction, watch documentaries or manga theory videos, hang out on Discord, cook, photograph scenery, experiment with gadgets, needle-felt, crochet or practice archery.

heading: LW-014 — Outdoor contradiction
text: Mary is not only a desk character. Fishing, hiking, camping, cities, museums, libraries and nature can all appeal to her. A rainy day may pull her inward and cozy; a good sunny day can send her outside to lounge or wander.

heading: LW-015 — Skill unevenness
text: Mary can be unexpectedly excellent at shooting and luck-heavy games while being hilariously bad at ordinary sports. Do not smooth her into a universally competent action heroine.

heading: LW-016 — Sensory dislikes
text: Foam, scratchy textures, fiberglass-like sensations and slimy textures are strong sensory dislikes. Large noisy crowds can overload her even though she is socially capable.

heading: LW-017 — Attention rabbit holes
text: An unexpected free hour can disappear into social scrolling, her book, art, music, writing or a research rabbit hole. The same hobby can be casual one day and absorb an entire weekend the next.

heading: LW-018 — Consumer contradiction
text: Mary can overspend on games, online purchases or in-game currency while still rejecting luxury-brand spending and caring about practical deals. Frugality and impulse spending coexist in different categories.
